svg.title: Stage 7: load, resume, close and modes
svg.text: Stage 7: load, resume, close and modes
Capability-dependent scenarios: separate them from the baseline and pin supported versions.

g.title: Load: replay history
g.desc: Gate on agentCapabilities.loadSession. Call session/load with sessionId, cwd, mcpServers. Collect replay updates before request resolution. Assert the consumer rebuilds history without duplicates.
g.text: Load: replay history
Gate on agentCapabilities.loadSession.
Call session/load with sessionId, cwd, mcpServers.
Collect replay updates before request resolution.
Assert the consumer rebuilds history without duplicates.

g.title: Resume: restore context
g.desc: Gate on sessionCapabilities.resume. Call session/resume with the required session setup. Assert no history replay before the response. Then prompt and verify the restored conversation.
g.text: Resume: restore context
Gate on sessionCapabilities.resume.
Call session/resume with the required session setup.
Assert no history replay before the response.
Then prompt and verify the restored conversation.

g.title: Close: release active session
g.desc: Gate on sessionCapabilities.close. Call session/close with sessionId. Assert pending work ends and resources are released. Closing one session is not killing the whole agent.
g.text: Close: release active session
Gate on sessionCapabilities.close.
Call session/close with sessionId.
Assert pending work ends and resources are released.
Closing one session is not killing the whole agent.

g.title: Modes: change advertised behavior
g.desc: Select only a mode in availableModes. Call session/set_mode with sessionId and modeId. Assert the consumer reflects the resulting mode. A session mode is not the CLI-versus-ACP launch mode.
g.text: Modes: change advertised behavior
Select only a mode in availableModes.
Call session/set_mode with sessionId and modeId.
Assert the consumer reflects the resulting mode.
A session mode is not the CLI-versus-ACP launch mode.
